messages:
maya: Observed regression on new model 'kumiko-v2' when quantized to int6. Mixed CJK+Arabic samples showing lost ruby readings and bracket reordering. BLEU delta ~ -7 vs fp16.

ori: can you share the eval snapshot and a failing example?

maya: eval-bot summary from suite mixed-cjk-ar-2026-03:
eval-bot: MODEL=kumiko-v2-int6 | TASK=mixed-cjk-ar-translate | QUANT=int6 | BLEU=24.3 (int6) vs 31.6 (fp16) | avg_tok/sent int6=17.1 fp16=12.3
example_input: "\u5d50(\u3042\u3089) said \u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645"
fp16_output: "\u5d50(\u3042\u3089) said \u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645"
int6_output: "\u5d50 said \u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645"

chen: token counts differ between runs?
yuki: quick token probe shows fp16 tokens=13, int6 tokens=19. That's a sign tokenization fallback or mismatched normalization in the int6 path.

ori: did the tokenizer or vocab change during model import?
maya: no. q8/q4 runs are near baseline. Only int6 runtime path triggers issue.

chen: suggest diffing token ids from both runtimes for the example and also checking preproc normalization table used by int6. Could be ZWJ/ZWSP special-casing.

yuki: adding deterministic detok roundtrip test for mixed-orientation samples to onboarding CI so we catch reorder/loss earlier.

maya: action items: 1) ori - bisect int6 kernel commits for where token-split skew appears; 2) chen - dump token ids + add quick repro script; 3) yuki - add detok smoke to onboarding CI. Marking onboard as hold until we understand root cause.

eval-bot: ticket created ML-1283 with failing examples and CI links: https://redwood.internal/ml/ML-1283

ori: starting bisect now, will report back with suspected commit or minimal repro.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
